apps.localizedDescription:
freepiv:

An open-source, cross-platform Pixiv browser with FANBOX and pixivision.

Browse illustrations and manga, read novels and articles, follow creators, and download artwork on Android, Windows, Linux, macOS, and iOS.

Features:

• Pixiv browsing: Recommendations, rankings, followed creators' updates, illustrations, manga, animated artwork, and novels.
• Search and discovery: Search works and users, filter results, browse tags, and revisit recent searches.
• Your library: Follow creators, bookmark works, and browse your account's collections.

• pixivision: Discover articles by category, tag, or keyword, explore popular articles, and open featured works and creators in the app.

versions.localizedDescription:
What's New:

• Redesigned interface: A new glass-style design with floating surfaces, spring animations, and artwork transitions across Pixiv, FANBOX, and pixivision.
• Appearance settings: Choose neutral, cool, or warm tones; customize light and dark accent colors separately; and enable Reduce transparency for solid surfaces.
• Search filters: Filter illustrations and manga by work type, shape, minimum size, and drawing tool. Search novels by tags, exact tags, body text, or keywords.
• Popular previews: View a single batch of up to 30 popular works in search results. Work type, shape, size, and tool filters do not apply to this preview.
• Novel reader: Added overlay controls, adjustable automatic scrolling, and optional volume-key navigation on Android.

Improvements:

• Search, FANBOX, and pixivision tabs now switch within the same page and retain their content. Tabbed pages also support mouse-drag navigation.

• Windows window titles now reflect the current page, artwork, or image being viewed.

Fixes:

• Fixed artwork flashing when completing a swipe-back gesture.
• Fixed layout shifts when opening the keyboard, missing titles in Android sidebar layouts, and duplicate Android clipboard notifications.

• Fixed image-loading errors not reaching retry handling, and corrected pixivision image placeholders and loading layouts.
• Fixed embedded artwork images missing from novel image galleries.
• Fixed an iOS Rust compilation failure caused by incompatible backtrace and libc dependencies.

Maintenance:

• Updated Flutter, Rust, Android build tools, and application dependencies.
• Moved shared interface components into frost_ui for consistent styling and behavior.
